rationale: No existing spec exercises the Traces search-result pagination. tracesSearch.spec.js covers search basics (stream select, run query, trace details) but never pages through results. service-catalog.spec.js paginates a different component (services-catalog OTable bottom bar), not the traces SearchResult OPagination driven by the streaming hasWritten fix (Issue #14317). The feature is a distinct regression with its own spec filename in run-context (spec_path = Traces/tracesStreamingPagination.spec.js); a dedicated spec keeps tracesSearch.spec.js (already a serial 9-test spec) from sprawling further. Must be registered in ci_matrix.json Traces run_files.
